notes.title: Demo Update - Tutorial hotfix
notes.content: [p]Hi Tanks,[/p][p][/p][p]I improved the tutorial so it now highlights what keybind is relevant for each step.[/p][p][/p][p]Also:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed visual bugs for ultrawide screens[/p][/*][*][p]Highlighted enemies further for better visibility[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in the tutorial where the instruction popup would disappear[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Waiting for your feedback in the Discord as always![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update - Environment changes, cycle target feature & more
notes.content: [p]Hi Tanks, new demo update with really cool stuff:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New environment graphics[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Targeting will prefer close enemies more often[/p][/*][*][p]Added a cycle target feature on Tab or LT that targets the closest enemy without aggro[/p][/*][*][p]Added a section to the tutorial to teach about cycling targets[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Additional bug fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed spellbook not making UI sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spellbook UI icon borders[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos in various upgrade options[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mini boss charging sometimes appear stuck inside the healer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed overall exp bar not being accurate to your current level[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update - Visual polish, revamped Nova, bug fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hi Tanks!
[/p][p]More tweaks/bug fixes/polish![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Nova now does significantly less damage (60 down from 500) but knocks back enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Vice Grip now unlocks after completing Tanking 201 instead of playing for an hour[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Talent Menu UI: added a visual cue to emphasize connected talents[/p][/*][*][p]Goblins now make a sound when knocked hard enough with Shield Throw[/p][/*][*][p]Visual changes to the level[/p][/*][*][p]Graphic quality settings "Low" "Medium" and "High" selectable from the settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some UI bugs around the spellbook menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI spacing issues, font mismatches and alignments across menus
[/p][/*][/list][p]Bug fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where consecration would overlap on the terrain[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where enemy healthbars would appear to teleport around[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update - Shield Starting Abilities, Gain Talents Faster
notes.content:
[p]Hi Tanks!
[/p][p]Watching you play the demo I realize it was taking a bit too long to unlock those tier 2 talents preciously needed to pass tanking 201.[/p][p]I also saw some frustration when the offensive ability (whirlwind/retribution) wasn't in the cards for the first few levels, so:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]Lowered exp required to unlock talent points, you should be getting 6 points now after your first clear![/p][/*][*][p]Crusader now starts with Whirlwind by default[/p][/*][*][p]Disc now starts with Retribution by default[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly buffed Whirlwind - increased radius by 20% and damage by 10[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Let me know if this streamlines the progression![/p]

notes.title: If you're sick of WoW's annoying teammates, Don't Lose Aggro is a must-play
notes.content:
Are you struggling to find the time to do raids that last all evening in your favorite MMO or MMORPG? You're older now, you've got to do the kids' bedtime and you know for sure they'll be banging on your bedroom door at 6am - another late night raiding just isn't on the cards. When you do set aside an evening for the latest event, do you find your party inevitably full of inexperienced players who throw the whole encounter? Maybe you'll enjoy Don't Lose Aggro, a single-player roguelike that aims to recreate the MMORPG raid experience without the time pressures or annoying teammates.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Demo Update: Tab-Target option, easier 101
notes.content: [p]Hi Tanks![/p][p]More nerfs to Tanking 101, added tab targeting support[/p][list][*][p]mobs amount reduced by half[/p][/*][*][p]exp gained per mob is therefore doubled [/p][/*][*][p]Tanking 201 will also see a 50% exp bonus per mob killed.[/p][/*][*][p]Traditional targeting system is available for keyboard & mouse users, under settings -> gameplay. left click to target, hold right click to rotate, use tab to cycle targets![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Come join the discord, its fun![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update - Better Targeting & New Upgrades
notes.content: [p]Hi Tanks![/p][p]I'm taking a crack at improving the targeting system, it should be easier to target enemies you're running towards now, let me know if its an improvement![/p][p]Additionally:[/p][list][*][p]New Upgrade: Shield Throw prioritizes enemeis without aggro.[/p][/*][*][p]New Upgrade: Dodges increase the next whirlwind damage, stacking effect.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Fixes/Tweaks:[/p][list][*][p]Buffed the underwhelming Healer upgrades at level 10[/p][/*][*][p]Healer health will now flash when she gets healed for more clarity and battlefield awareness[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed Shield Throw's search radius[/p][/*][*][p]Dodge combat text is white to contrast from all the damage going on[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See you in the Discord![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update - Balance
notes.content: [p]Hi Tanks![/p][p][/p][p]Watching you play I realize Taunt and Pull were too weak, and needed a buff, also realized only a fraction of players managed to clear the first level without giving up, so nerfing that one a little![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Pull redesign: Now targets in an area around you (up to 20 enemies) and roots in place for 3 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]New possible Taunt upgrade that heals you for every enemy taunted[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the mini boss in Tanking 101, this inverse mob that rages on your healer only comes at Tanking 201 now.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Let me know how it plays, Discord is open![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: Movement key rebinding
notes.content: [p]Added Movement keys rebinding as well as companion ability rebinding[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45122690/541f1b22db065c3e20247dcaaad0f0db1c562ab1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content: [p]Hi Tanks![/p][p]TL;DR:[/p][list][*][p]Green health bars (aggro'd) are now hidden by default but can be brought back via settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added indication for cooldown remaining on "Holy Nova" talent[/p][/*][*][p]Changed ability descriptions, hopefully they are clearer now[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the shield unlocked conditions so Disc gets played with first ideally[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks a lot for the feedback on the demo so far![/p][p]Implementing your thoughts, I have added a feature that hides health bars of already aggro'd enemies.[/p][p]This is on by default but can be turned off in the settings, for those who want to still see them.[/p][p][/p][p]This is not a change I'm taking light headed as this takes away some of the control over the battlefield, not knowing the exact health of all present enemies can backfire, so please let me know what you think of this change![/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, I added another cast bar for the healer that displays the remaining CD of "Holy Nova" for those who spec into it, should help maneuver your CDs around.[/p][p][/p][p]As always waiting for your feedback both on the demo page and the Discord feedback channel![/p]

notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.content: [p]Tanks![/p][p][/p][p]Excited to share that after almost 2 years of development, the demo for the first ever MMO-like tanking is live![/p][p][/p][p]Try it out, leave a review and if you liked it, wishlist the full game because I have massive plans for it, including:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Dungeon crawl mode with plenty of difficulty levels, timers, affixes and modifiers.[/p][/*][*][p]Multi companion feature where you will protect a whole party and not just one![/p][/*][*][p]Boss-only modes with various bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Wide variety of companions like healers, rogues and necromancers.[/p][/*][*][p]Much more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always waiting for your feedback on Discord, come chat![/p]

notes.title: Playtest Ending
notes.content:
Hi Tanks,

In preperations for releasing the game's demo, the playtest version will be closing on October 17th.

I wanted to thank everyone who participated and gave feedback for the game, it was truly an honor to see you play Don't Lose Aggro's concept version.

Stay tuned for demo release coming very soon!
Oren

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
I wanted to start off saying thanks to everyone who is taking part in the playtest!
Playtesting is the most effective way to ensure that the game reaches the heights it's meant for, and comes off overall a better game.

More playtesters are needed! Just hit the request access on the page and you will automatically be granted the current version of the game.

This update comes from your feedback as players who requested an alternative control scheme, so I prioritized the implementation of gamepad support.

Now fully playable with gamepads, you can tank (almost) as well as with keyboard mouse!

Let me know how it plays.
Oren

notes.title: Playtest is live - Don't Lose Aggro
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Excited to announce play testing of the Don't Lose Aggro is now live!
This early stage of development is where you as players come in and let me know what you like and dislike about the core game mechanics, which is super important.

Opt in, play the game, and leave feedback either in the Discord or the community hub on Steam.
Any feedback is relevant, so please don't hesitate!

And don't forget to add DLA to your wishlist!

Happy tanking,
Oren
